svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.25.3.4 Air Leakage Control in Masonry Walls
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.25.3.4 Air Leakage Control in Masonry Walls
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.25 HEAT TRANSFER, AIR LEAKAGE AND CONDENSATION CONTROL
Air Leakage Control in Masonry Walls

g.text: A course of units without voids at the level of
the floor and sealed to it, (1)(a), (2)(a)
Flashing across the full width at the level
of the floor and sealed to it, (1)(b), (2)(a)
No floor: the course is at the level of the
ground cover and sealed to it, (2)(b)

svg.text: Masonry walls required to provide a barrier to
the ingress of air from the ground
(a) include a course of masonry units without
voids, or (b) are sealed with flashing material
extending across the full width of the masonry.
The masonry course or flashing described in
(a) located at the level of the adjoining floor
and sealed to it in accordance with Article
9.25.3.6., or (b) in the absence of a floor,
located at the level of the ground cover required
by Article 9.18.6.1. and sealed to it.

The Article heading carries "(See Note A-9.25.3.4. and 9.25.3.6.)". Drawn: hollow units cut at the end, the course without voids in yellow, seals as red dashed lines. Flashing thickness is exaggerated.
